title: npm client sends credentials on every request
description: .npmrc declares a client setting that attaches registry credentials to every request, not only to authenticated calls. The token is offered to mirrors, proxies and any host the client is pointed at, which widens the audience of one leaked configuration.
remediation: Leave `always-auth` unset so credentials are only sent where the registry requires them.
limitation: It matches a client setting that attaches registry credentials to every request, not only to authenticated calls in the parsed .npmrc; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
